content.title: Chapter 34 - EMERGENCY SERVICES — Sec. 34-75. - Enforcement.
content.summary:
In the event of a violation of this section, or of any lawful rules or regulations
               promulgated hereunder, the city may institute proceedings in the county court of appropriate
               jurisdiction to enforce the provisions of this section.
(Code 1981, § 2-191(e); Ord. No. 1745,…
